messages:
mara: Quick heads-up — discovered p95 mem spike in model-serve. I pushed a targeted kvcache eviction tweak to image `redwood/serve:1.2.4-hotfix`. Need an expedited overnight window 02:00-02:15 PST to roll a canary and then full if green.

deploy-bot: Deploy request received for redwood/serve:1.2.4-hotfix. CI checks: unit ✅, integration ✅, e2e queued. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 5m observation each.

jen: Quick triage: change is one-line eviction condition and a small safety guard. No schema or migration. ML owner reviewed +1. Patch diff: ```diff
- if (!kvHit) evict()
+ if (!kvHit && usage > 0.8) evict()
```

tony: I'm on-call for that window. I can monitor. Recommend we pin canary to eu-west1 first (lower traffic) then roll global if stable. If errors spike -> rollback immediately.

sylas: I can't join live at 02:00 but I approve the rollback plan and the image. Add the rollback command to the thread so infra can run quickly.

mara: Rollback command to keep handy: `kubectl -n modelserv rollout undo deploy/model-serve --to-revision=rev-20240210` — tagging release note draft at /docs/releases/1.2.4-hotfix

releasebot: Release note stub created: https://go/release/1.2.4-hotfix (please fill in QA summary).

deploy-bot: Canary started in eu-west1 (5%). Monitoring: https://internal/mon/model-serve/canary-1754321000. Auto-rollback threshold: 4xx+5xx rate > 1.5x baseline OR p95 latency > 1.2x baseline for 2 consecutive windows.

jen: Smoke checks passing so far (2m). No increase in 5xx, p95 stable. :thumbsup:

ton y: (typo fix) tony: Seen same on telemetry, green at 5%. Proceeding to 25% now.

deploy-bot: 25% stage complete. Observing for 5m.

jen: After 5m looks good. No spike in errors. Rolling to 100%.

mara: Rolling to 100% now. Kicking post-deploy smoke: `curl -fsS https://modelserv/health || true` then quick embed sanity run.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete. All health checks OK. No auto-rollback triggered.

sylas: Thanks — I reviewed the release note. LGTM.

ton y: Verified production p95 and error rates normal. Marking window closed.

mara: Closing thread — hotfix deployed and release note updated. Will follow up with a short postmortem if we see any regressions. :white_check_mark:
